rider_report.mid_session_status: Anaerobic intervals completed and synced. Rider was at the bottom/finish line of 2K and asked whether to do slow repeats.
rider_report.coach_call: No slow repeats; ride home very easy only.
rider_report.ftp_context: Garmin activity detail shows functionalThresholdPower 214 W after this session; prior 2026-06-16 Stumpjumper file showed 227 W.
rider_report.evening_status: After dinner, rider plans to target 8+ hours of sleep. Clipless comfort is improving; main remaining issue is failure to unclip during sudden stops.
rider_report.stumpjumper_setup_feedback: Rider noticed clipless changes body posture forward enough that suspension feel changed. Fork rebound damping increased by 1 click and shock rebound damping reduced by 1 click.
rider_report.technical_feedback: Clipless allows a slightly more forward attacking posture and better control into steep chutes with corners before/after compared with flat pedals.
rider_report.second_session_context: The second 36 min file was not only a low-intensity ride back to the car park. Rider included a half-2K verification run after changing fork and shock rebound during the interval session.
rider_report.second_session_technical_result: During the half-2K verification, rider felt more confident attacking a steep chute on both corner entry and exit despite a slightly tired body.

coach_notes.summary: The above-FTP/anaerobic stimulus is complete. Treat this as the hard engine session for the week.

evening_ride_home_load.interpretation: This file included a deliberate half-2K setup verification, not just an easy ride back to the car park.

same_day_total_mtb_load_estimate.note: Two separate 2026-06-19 MTB files are present after evening sync; this materially changes tomorrow's density call.

coach_notes.clipless_limiter: Sudden stops are the current risk point; planned practice should include low-speed surprise-stop drills before technical consequence.
coach_notes.setup_interpretation: The technical result is positive because confidence improved on steep chute entry and exit while mildly fatigued. Treat clipless/body-position adaptation as the primary change and suspension feel as a secondary setup consequence. Do not change more suspension variables tomorrow; validate the fork/shock rebound changes on the same trail context before further adjustment.
setup_validation_criteria: Fork must not pack down on repeated hits or steep chute entries.
Rear must not kick, wallow, or unload unpredictably on corner exits.
Chassis must recover without pitching when linking steep chute entry to corner exit.
Rider must keep front-tyre authority without relying on clipless to pull the bike around.
Sudden-stop unclipping must become automatic before increasing consequence.
